rules: When executing VLE32FF.V, masked-off elements never generate exceptions.
When executing VLE32FF.V, destination elements corresponding to masked-off elements are handled with either a mask-undisturbed or mask-agnostic policy depending on the setting of vtype.vma.
When executing VLE32FF.V with unit-stride addressing, the effective vector length is evl = ceil(vl /8), and the destination register is always written with a tail-agnostic policy.
When executing VLE32FF.V with unit-stride addressing and fault-only-first mode, the instruction only takes a trap caused by a synchronous exception on element 0.

When executing VLE32FF.V with unit-stride addressing and fault-only-first mode, if an element greater than 0 raises an exception, the corresponding trap is not taken, and the vector length vl is reduced to the index of the element that would have raised an exception.
When executing VLE32FF.V, the element width is 32 bits, and the memory access size is 32 bits.
